summary: Agree Realty Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement registering $1.75 billion of common stock for an at-the-market (ATM) offering program. The registrant is raising equity through sales agents and forward sale agreements, with shares sold on the NYSE at prevailing market prices ($77.25/share as of April 23, 2026). The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural changes beyond capital raising. The program replaced a prior ATM program from October 2024. What to watch: sales depend on market conditions; no arbitrage angle as this is a standard equity distribution.
